submission.justification: Absorber-F3 at 4mm plate thickness provides the best energy resolution of 3.149% at 100 GeV, outperforming Absorber-F1 (3.672%) and Absorber-F2 (5.199%) at their respective optimal thicknesses. The 4mm thickness falls well within the required 2-10mm range and represents the optimal point for this material. CRITICAL CAVEAT: Dose rate data after cooldown is not available in the simulation results. The hard constraint of ≤20 µSv/h at 1m after one week of cooldown must be verified experimentally or through additional radiation transport simulations before final implementation. This recommendation is conditional on passing the dose rate requirement.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV
